insights: Shorts perform drastically better than long-form videos, averaging over 1,000 views compared to under 100 views for long-form content.
Space and astronomy topics achieve the highest engagement and view completion rates, exemplified by NASA and space-related shorts scoring averages above 110% view duration.
Early retention drops consistently between the 4th and 8th seconds across multiple shorts, indicating that hooks need tighter phrasing to prevent immediate drop-off.
Call-to-action questions at the end of videos fail to generate comments across almost all uploads, showing that the current ending prompt strategy is ineffective.
Long-form deep dives suffer from extremely low initial discovery and poor click-through from external sources, making format prioritization on shorts essential given current channel size.
